niche.habitat: Geothermal frost-plains & vent chimneys (0.08 W/m² flux)
niche.active: Diurnal (slow metabolic cycle aligned to vent output)

body: Low-slung, plate-armored siloxane carapace with broad ventral rasping pads and IR thermal pits

links: Scrapes fluoride-etched cryo-glass for reactive silicon
HF volcanic gases break inert Si–O bonds in reducing air

skill.effect: Degrades enemy silicate armor by 15% over 3s, releasing H2 fuel for allies

chains.weakness: Pad joints stiffen below 60 K, slowing attack speed by 40%

journal.en: It doesn't eat; it slowly digests the mountain.

plausibility.summary: Frame diet as scraping vent-deposited, fluoride-etched silicate scale and organosilicon mat at chimneys; tie H₂ release to abrading Si–H biomineral coatings, not intact quartz. Slow Glass Grind to match vent diurnal heat (F12), not 3s full armor strip.
fixes: Frame diet as scraping vent-deposited, fluoride-etched silicate scale and organosilicon mat at chimneys; tie H₂ release to abrading Si–H biomineral coatings, not intact quartz. Slow Glass Grind to match vent diurnal heat (F12), not 3s full armor strip.

analogues.organism: Limpets and chitons (Patellogastropoda, Polyplacophora) — radula and odontophore scrape biofilms and rock; fluoride etching parallels industrial HF glass frosting (not biological).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Distributes mechanical stress across brittle siloxane plates
Low gravity permits larger exoskeletal frames without collapse

skill.effect: Shields party from one thermal shock, reflecting 20% heat damage back

chains.weakness: High-frequency sounds fracture plate seams, causing stagger

journal.en: Built like a moving glacier, patience is its only armor.

plausibility.summary: Reduced gravity (F4) eases loading on a broad, brittle siloxane/silicate plate exoskeleton (F14). Low stance lowers overturning torque on frost plains and distributes stress across overlaps — sensible for territorial, slow grazers near vents.
fixes: Reduced gravity (F4) eases loading on a broad, brittle siloxane/silicate plate exoskeleton (F14). Low stance lowers overturning torque on frost plains and distributes stress across overlaps — sensible for territorial, slow grazers near vents.

analogues.organism: Giant isopods (Bathynomus) and trilobite-derived plate arrangements — distributed exoskeletal stress in low-energy lifestyles.

links: Detects subtle heat differentials in perpetual fog
Dense N₂/CH₄ atmosphere and low visible flux blind optical sight

skill.effect: Marks hidden enemies within 30m, increasing ally accuracy by 25%

chains.weakness: Blinded by uniform ambient heat sources (e.g., thermal vents)

journal.en: It sees what it feels, and the feeling is always hunger.

plausibility.summary: Perpetual frost fog and weak visible flux (F10, F19) make optical hunting poor; sub-degree thermal contrast near vents and prey metabolic micro-heats (F15) is a reliable cue. Confusion near uniform vent fields matches saturation limits of IR sensors.
fixes: Perpetual frost fog and weak visible flux (F10, F19) make optical hunting poor; sub-degree thermal contrast near vents and prey metabolic micro-heats (F15) is a reliable cue. Confusion near uniform vent fields matches saturation limits of IR sensors.

chains.weakness: Cannot evade rapid strikes or sudden environmental shifts

journal.en: Speed is a luxury the cold denies; endurance is its currency.

temperament: Patient, territorial, moves with grinding precision
secrets: Its rasping pads secrete a mild acid that temporarily liquefies CH₄, creating slip-angles for escape.
The IR pits can detect the metabolic heat of prey hiding under ice.
moments: A sudden vent burst turns the fog glass-white; it doesn't flinch, only opens its pads and waits for the wind to carry the new chemistry.

journal.en: Patience is not a virtue here. It is a thermodynamic necessity.
It remembers the mountain's heat long after the vent goes cold.
